goal.criterion: Make the existing reviewed delivery controller consume immutable actual Fleet runtimes and retain a verifiable predecessor
goal.rationale: Replace the demonstrated one-shot continuation with a reusable owner-controlled delivery component; retain existing Releases and ReleaseQueue authority.

plan.objective: Implement ONLY Operating-host composition: immutable runtime consumption in bound SPEC. Reuse existing HostDelivery/Queue/Releases/background_service/Fleet owners; explicit opt-in, preserve legacy behavior. Current production stays unchanged. Runtime snapshots immutable and owner-derived; real Fleet entry, truthful pause/drain/heartbeat and loaded identity; rollback old code. Keep candidate command/path authority absent. Exactly one consolidated batch and matrix, no unrelated audit. Tests use labelled local fixtures, no production mutations or model calls. Plain replayable python -m pytest and python -m ruff check commands in final tests list, no timeout shell prefix, no --fix claims. Read bounded excerpts and keep output compact. Independent reviewer covers full changed path; actual operating cutover remains owner work.
acceptance_criteria: Owner-only immutable runtime materialization and exact actual child consumption; candidate has no arbitrary host command/path authority.
Real Fleet optional pause/drain/heartbeat is truthful, preserves running children, and refuses unknown idle.
Forward/restart/lost-response/concurrent-owner/rollback scenarios retain exact predecessor code and existing instance/fence authority.
Existing modes and relevant tests remain compatible; Windows/POSIX/fixture/actual distinctions and all failures are recorded.
Structured existing observations and read-only projection expose progress; no self-approval or production action.
